status_semantics: Numerical failure takes precedence when any row fails a gate. Coverage status and per-row execution/validation retain every unverified configuration.

expert_tp_ownership_diagnostics.scope: CPU synthetic buffer geometry using pinned checkpoint factories, optimizer ownership algorithms and library mapping; not a dump of the failed GPU buffer ranges.
expert_tp_ownership_diagnostics.pinned_code_finding: Expert weights use expert TP, but EP=1 marks them for the ordinary DP optimizer even when expert TP differs from attention TP.

routing_diagnostics.scope: Step 0 of separate tiny-MoE probe attempts only. Original numerical results and policies are unchanged.
routing_diagnostics.capture: HF sets are derived with its exact routing formula; native sets and weights are actual router returns. Receipt, raw and probe checksums and sizes were verified.
routing_diagnostics.coordinate_limit: Input, logits and routing fields are checked separately but share each probe row's token positions.

cpu_projection.precision: FP32 with independent BF16-rounded initial router weights

cpu_counterfactual.precision: FP32 eager; no backward or optimizer
cpu_counterfactual.intervention: Force the native expert sets and recompute normalized selected weights from current HF logits.
cpu_counterfactual.limit: This changes routing; it cannot qualify the original GPU run, identify an upstream fault, or validate gradients and updates.
